Name: Unique Fish Additions
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
a mod that adds 40 unique and strange fish/foragables/crabpot fish to some areas of the game (specifically the beach, secret forest pond and ginger island)
i have a strong affinity for "bizarre" aquatic creatures and feel stardew could always use more of them :)

. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/V93CvTp.png[/img]
﻿1. download and install content patcher
2. download this mod
3. unzip folder into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/nA1APYR.png[/img]
♡[b] Chinese translation: [/b]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17637
♡ i hope to add more fish in the future!
♡ all sprites were made by me
